name: Katana
author: J.AkioHonda
modifications: glTF resources embedded into GLB; original geometry and PBR textures preserved. Presentation orientation reset; sheath opening and blade collar calibrated from geometry, normalized, and grouped for reversible unsheathing. Separate awakening light layer, original procedural mist and ink artwork, studio lighting, and a stone impact setting added. Original procedural moonlit bamboo grove and instanced silhouette katana field added. Desktop and portrait chapter posters rendered.

preview.credit: Preview render from the creator’s Sketchfab model page. Cropped for presentation.
